protocol_audit.lane_authorization: NOT ESTABLISHED: standing project README states the session lane paragraph was absent; H46 was selected from a prior next-step suggestion. No promotion is permitted under the literal lane rule.
preregistration_deviations: Frozen pre-registration specified a 70/30 Regime-A/Regime-B budget split (26,358 / 11,296 dots); the executed run used 72/28 (27,111 / 10,543). The executed experiment is therefore not the preregistered split.
Frozen pre-registration specified F2mDAB > +1 C; the executed plume input used every positive value > 0 C before clipping.
The frozen plan named T2m-T1m; the executed vertical-gradient channel instead used T2m-T15m, where the source schema labels T15m as 1.5 m.
Frozen pre-registration specified a 150 m TIGER road veto scale; the executed feature used 180 m.

The executed point importer retained points within a 24-pixel padding and clipped their coordinates to the footprint edge, rather than filtering to true in-footprint points before plume interpolation. The code was corrected after execution; the corrected feature stack was not rebuilt or validated in this run.
protocol_audit.impact: H46 model holdout and SGMC numbers are exploratory diagnostics only, not admissible preregistered promotion evidence. The output remains a valid saved-byte format artifact, but it must not be submitted.
corrective_shared_code_changes_after_run: src/gems32/trhv.py now filters mapped 2-m probe and paleo-geothermal points to the actual finite sample_submission.tif footprint before rasterization, rather than clipping points outside the footprint onto edge cells. The executed candidate used the earlier edge-clipping implementation.
The runner/module now use the preregistered 70/30 allocation, F2mDAB > 1 C threshold, and 150 m TIGER scale. The executed candidate used 72/28, F2mDAB > 0 C, and 180 m.
protocol_audit.no_rebuild_after_stop: No corrected H46 rerun was performed: the prompt does not provide an explicit assigned lane and the preregistered three-arm budget has already been consumed.
protocol_audit.shared_emitter_fix_timing: The shared emitter initial_mask residual-coverage implementation and rho acceptance-bar correction were committed to the working tree and unit-tested before the completed H46 run; 13 emitter tests passed at that point.
